2024_general.fact: Before 2025 Bexar posted Electionware HTML, not Clarity (media release of April 25, 2025 announces a "New Election Night Reporting System"). home.bexar.org/el45a.html (linked as "Election Results" from home.bexar.org) is "Summary Results Report ... November 5, 2024 UNOFFICIAL RESULTS Vote Center 302 of 302 Bexar County", printed "Election Summary - 11/06/2024 1:10 AM", Last-Modified Wed 06 Nov 2024 07:11:00 GMT (1:11 AM CST): county totals only. The only precinct report listed for this election on elections.bexar.gov/35/Historical is "November 5, 2024 Official Precinct Report" (PDF printed "Precinct Summary - 11/19/2024 11:18 AM", OFFICIAL RESULTS; CSV also). No election-night precinct report is listed. Precinct numbers came at canvass. DocumentCenter files carry no Last-Modified header.

2026_primary.fact: Results were on Clarity from 2025, but Bexar's Clarity elections.json is empty and the county site now links only EID 127291 (the November 3, 2026 election). No link to the March 3, 2026 EID was found on elections.bexar.gov, www.bexar.org or home.bexar.org (election, historical, media and news pages checked; two logged web searches). County-posted reports for this election are official or reconciliation totals only (March 3, 2026 Primary Results PDF printed 04/06/2026 7:43 AM OFFICIAL; Preliminary Reconciliation is a scan, CreationDate 4 Mar 2026 07:44 UTC). Check 3 pending (wayback-data branch not present).

2026_runoff.fact: Same as primary: no county-site link to the runoff Clarity EID found. Posted reports: Joint Primary Runoff Official Results PDF printed 06/02/2026 1:28 PM; Precinct Official Results Report printed "Precinct Summary - 06/02/2026 1:39 PM"; Preliminary Reconciliation scan CreationDate 27 May 2026 05:50 UTC (totals). Check 3 pending.

rationale: Only 2024_general is determined (LATER, check 2), so the tag is COUNTY_ONLY_PRECINCT_AT_CANVASS with low confidence. The two 2026 elections, on the new Clarity system, could not be checked because no county-site link to their EIDs was found and check 3 data is not yet available.

comparison_notes.2026_primary: different: research LIVE (check 1, EID 125927), verifier UNDETERMINED. I found no link to a March 2026 Clarity EID on the county's own sites (elections.bexar.gov, www.bexar.org, home.bexar.org); the county links only EID 127291 (Nov 2026). Research took EIDs 125927 and 126369 from Wikipedia and San Antonio Report pages, not from a county page; the brief and pilot note require EIDs from links on the county's own results or election pages.
